```{r}
#loading packages
library(xml2)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
```

```{r}
xml_compounds_to_tibble <- function(path,
                                   record_xpath = ".//Compounds",
                                   col_types = NULL,
                                   add_source = TRUE) {
  doc <- read_xml(path)

  nodes <- xml_find_all(doc, record_xpath)

  rows <- map(nodes, function(node) {
    kids <- xml_children(node)
    nms  <- xml_name(kids)
    vals <- xml_text(kids)

    # Normalize empty strings to NA
    vals <- na_if(str_trim(vals), "")

    as.list(setNames(vals, nms))
  })

  out <- bind_rows(rows) |> as_tibble()

  # Convert types if provided (keeps unspecified columns as character)
  if (!is.null(col_types)) {
    out <- type_convert(out, col_types = col_types, na = c("", "NA"))
  }

  if (add_source) {
    out <- mutate(out, source_file = basename(path), .before = 1)
  }

  out
}
```

```{r}
combine_four_xml <- function(paths,
                             record_xpath = ".//Compounds",
                             col_types = NULL,
                             add_source = TRUE) {
  stopifnot(length(paths) == 4)

  map_dfr(
    paths,
    ~ xml_compounds_to_tibble(.x,
                              record_xpath = record_xpath,
                              col_types = col_types,
                              add_source = add_source)
  )
}
```

```{r}
compound_types <- cols(
  Number                  = col_integer(),
  Peak_Name               = col_character(),
  Retention_Time          = col_double(),
  Amount                  = col_double(),
  Peak_Area               = col_double(),   # could be integer but safe as double
  Units                   = col_character(),
  Cal_Istd                = col_integer(),
  QValue                  = col_integer(),
  Expected_Retention_Time = col_double(),

  Target_Ion              = col_double(),
  Qualifier1_Ion          = col_double(),
  Qualifier2_Ion          = col_double(),
  Qualifier3_Ion          = col_double(),

  Start_Integration        = col_double(),
  End_Integration          = col_double()
)
```

```{r}

ff <-list.files("../practice_tdu_data/",pattern="xml")

all_compounds <- combine_four_xml(
  paths = files,
  record_xpath = ".//Compounds",
  col_types = compound_types,

glimpse(all_compounds)

write_csv(all_compounds, "blk_4_ff23")
```
